Drawback: Recoil.name: Drawback: Recoil
Drawback: Recoil.description:
💥 Your Quirk kicks back: the force you put out returns through the limbs that send it.

⚠️ Big uses jar your bones and joints.
⚠️ Push too far and the recoil breaks them.
🎬 Similar canon Quirk: Katsuki Bakugo (Explosion).

🎒 Starts with: Recoil-dampening bracers
Drawback: Recoil.traitNarrativeEffects: Each use drives part of the Quirk's force back into the body part that channels it: usually hands, arms and shoulders, or legs for a kick-driven Quirk. Quirk Strain 60 (50 for an Exceptional Quirk): each use jars the user; hands shake, joints ache, aim drifts after a big use. Quirk Strain 80: the drawback is active; any use beyond light bruises bone or splits skin where the force leaves (minor injury), and the user braces visibly before each use. Quirk Strain 100: the recoil breaks something (a finger, wrist, forearm or shoulder), a serious injury, and no Quirk use until Strain falls below 60. Signs fade as Strain falls below each threshold. Recoil-dampening bracers absorb part of the kick: worn, they keep the 60-stage shaking out of the user's aim; they do not stop the 80 or 100 stages. Ordinary life: small everyday uses, old bruises, taped fingers, known by name at the nearest clinic. Quirkless: no Quirk, no Strain; the bracers are spare gear.
